title: Screen-Based Robot Face Timeline
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Interpret the sequence of milestones across four commercial screen-faced robots and summarize how one company's outcome (Anki's shutdown) relates in time to the releases of the other robots.
